title: Lost-ack durable receipt recovery across coordinator and HTTP server recreation
scope: CPU-only real HTTP/Store + FlowModel. Test pauses after actual Store.move returns its durable receipt but before coordinator acknowledgement; drops the client connection; recreates coordinator and HTTP server over the same canonical store; then resubmits the exact answer POST.
assertions: Store.move has committed and its presentation receipt is visible while the original durable future is still pending.
The interrupted stream has no complete event.
After coordinator/server recreation, /cow/operation returns process-scoped 404, while the exact original answer POST returns the original durable receipt.
Replay performs no additional FlowModel work and leaves the current branch head/revision unchanged.
Changed arguments under the same operation ID are rejected with the existing HTTP 400 Operation ID reused for different input response; work and branch head remain unchanged.

broad_serving_regressions.scope_note: The existing verify_cow_serving.py list does not execute the new postcommit test; that test ran separately above. Its result manifest records the final new-module source hash.

preserved_setup_attempts.classification: test harness setup error: fixture object lacked make_text
test harness setup failure: patch targeted the coordinator Store instead of FlowModel's publication Store, so the durable-boundary gate was never reached
test harness setup error: fixture helper new_coordinator was called on the wrong object

limitations: This recreates coordinator and HTTP server objects in one CPU test process; it does not exercise OS process-kill recovery or native child-process recovery.
FlowModel is synthetic. No GPU, model, or ordinary-chat qualification was performed.
Existing behavior already passed the deterministic replay test; no production fix was required, so prior setup failures are not behavioral RED evidence.
